result.reason: The operative language gives Licensee the required affiliate and M&A assignment carve-outs and removes Licensor's change-of-control termination right, but it does not restrict Licensor's assignments, require Customer consent for them, or prohibit assignment to a Customer competitor. It therefore reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. It also leaves in place the Article XXII right of first refusal and retains an internally inconsistent sentence addressing when Licensor may reasonably withhold consent to a Change of Control even though such consent is no longer required. Adding prohibitions on suspension and repricing goes beyond the stated no-termination requirement. The margin comment cannot cure these operative defects, and existing drafting errors and broken cross-references remain.
